name: Joash Lim
pillar: Operations Lead // Supply Chain & AI Systems
summary: I sit where engineering meets operations. Trained in mechatronics and now in systems design with a focus on analytics, operations research and supply chain, I've built warehouse forecasting at Love, Bonito, deployed robots at a live event, scaled an expert workforce in London, and run client onboarding for the AI startup I co-founded. I make complex systems run, on time and in the real world.

artifacts.title: INFINEON — Multi-Modal RAG Pipeline
artifacts.summary: Dual-path hybrid search with custom score fusion; 96% accuracy under LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. CBS Data & Business Analytics Project Award 2026.

project details.description: A multi-modal RAG pipeline that combines text and image embeddings for improved retrieval. The system uses a dual-path approach with custom score fusion to enhance accuracy, achieving 96% accuracy under LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. This project was recognized with the CBS Data & Business Analytics Project Award in 2026.

artifacts.title: LOVE, BONITO — Warehouse Forecasting & 3PL Tracking
artifacts.summary: Built warehouse forecasting and 3PL KPI tracking; ran UAT for the SAP, OMS and WMS integration across the SG and MY distribution centres.

artifacts.title: THE ROBOT COMPANY — Full-Swerve Robot Deployment
artifacts.summary: Engineered and deployed a full-swerve robotic system for AI Engineer Singapore 2026, balancing battery life, weight and payload.

artifacts.title: APTURA — Expert Operations Scale-Up
artifacts.summary: Scaled a finance-expert data-labelling team from 6 to 50+ and improved onboarding efficiency 3–4x.

whyMe: A capstone fails when the plan looks good on paper but breaks at delivery. I make sure it doesn't. I've run UAT, written SOPs, scaled teams and shipped hardware to a live event — I keep the timeline, the stakeholders and the system moving together, so the partner gets something that actually works inside their operations.
